metadata.description: Open-source, governed legal workflow plugins maintained by l0cka.

plugins.name: australian-ai-governance
plugins.description: Map, assess and monitor Australian AI governance obligations using verified official sources, current-versus-superseded guidance labelling and human-review gates.

plugins.name: australian-aml-ctf
plugins.description: Map, review and monitor AML/CTF obligations for Australian legal practices under the tranche 2 reforms using verified official sources, designated-service mapping, legal-professional-privilege handling and human-review gates.

plugins.name: australian-corporations-governance
plugins.description: Configure, assess and document Australian company governance using verified Corporations Act sources and approved organisational controls.

plugins.name: australian-employment-fair-work
plugins.description: Map the Fair Work Act, National Employment Standards, modern award and enterprise agreement layers that apply to an Australian employment arrangement; issue-spot termination exposure; review workplace policies against current statutory hooks; and track Fair Work developments. Every conclusion stays with the responsible lawyer.

plugins.name: australian-estate-planning
plugins.description: Prepare solicitor-review drafts for one NSW, Victorian or Queensland client from centrally maintained approved estate planning precedents, an approved drafting playbook and provenance-cited instructions. Draft supported content, visibly flag every unresolved issue and return a matching drafting-issues register.

plugins.name: australian-legal-research
plugins.description: Verify Australian legislation, case citations and quoted passages against official publishers, trace Commonwealth legislative change, and draft AGLC4 citations.

plugins.name: australian-litigation-deadlines
plugins.description: Map limitation periods and compute candidate procedural deadlines for Australian civil litigation using script-only date arithmetic, evidence-gated computation-rule tables, official-publisher sources and human-confirmation gates — every date is provisional until the responsible lawyer confirms it.

plugins.name: australian-privacy-cybersecurity
plugins.description: Route and verify Australian privacy, cyber incident, statutory tort, automated-decision and AI-use-case issues using current legislation.

plugins.name: legal-evidence-workflows
plugins.description: Build source-linked document indexes, evidence chronologies, candidate-only privilege logs and inconsistency maps as Word documents from supplied legal matter documents while preserving conflicts, uncertainty and human review.

plugins.name: legal-triage
plugins.description: Configure and conduct governed, staff-facing legal enquiry triage for Australian community legal centres.

plugins.name: legal-workflow-router
plugins.description: Route an Australian legal fact pattern to the Legal Skills plugins and skills it engages, in a defensible order, with the human decision points named. Never answers the legal question itself.
